overview: This Senate resolution congratulates Southeastern Louisiana University in Hammond, Louisiana, on its 100th anniversary. It recounts the school's founding in 1925 as Hammond Junior College with 40 students, its growth into a university in 1970, and its current enrollment of more than 15,000 students across five colleges and schools. It recognizes the university's work in education, research and community service and sends copies to school leaders. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on May 8, 2025.
for: Supporters say it honors a century of public higher education serving Louisiana students and communities.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic: it does not change any law or spending.
